original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist was hospitalised for much of the renewal cycle and completed only part of her required continuing education. She wants to renew. What does the regulation direct her to do?

choices.text: Self-certify the shortfall on the renewal application and renew without further steps.
Renew now and complete the missing contact hours within the following calendar year.
Submit a sworn detailed statement of the extenuating circumstances for the Board to determine.
Apply for retired status until the missing contact hours can be completed.
Request that her employer certify the extenuating circumstances directly to the Board.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist realizes before renewal that required CE hours are missing and looks for the notice method described in the currently posted CE policy.

Case B: After notifying the Massachusetts Board about missing hours, the pharmacist assumes the deficiency has been waived without a Board decision.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The current policy directs the pharmacist to email a detailed explanatory statement to the Board.
Sending the explanatory email automatically waives the remaining hours.
The CE email instruction abolishes all mandatory-disclosure requirements.
A pharmacist may attest to compliance once a future CE course has been booked.

The CE notice method does not eliminate unrelated mandatory-disclosure duties.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: 직접 접종하지 않고 감독한 약사의 annual immunization CE trigger를 적용한다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 직접 접종하지 않고 감독한 약사의 annual immunization CE trigger를 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CDTM 추가5시간은 협약의 실무영역과 일반적으로 관련되어야 한다. 무관한 CE로 추가시간을 전부 대체할 수 없다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 여러 clinical practice area의 추가 교육은 권고와 구별하며 정책은 총25시간만 요구한다고 명시한다. 협약 수마다 무조건5시간씩 법정 최소를 더하는 문장은 맞지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 초기 immunizer 교육과 매년 유지 immunization CE는 별개다. 초기교육 완료가 후속 annual CE를 없애지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 현행 정책은 실제 접종자와 immunizing activity의 직접 감독자 모두 매년1시간을 요구한다. 규정의 2년 주기 최소와 정책의 연간 요건을 구별하여 정책 질문에 답했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 직접 접종하지 않고 감독한 약사의 annual immunization CE trigger를 적용한다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 면역업무를 감독하면서 CDTM을 수행하는 약사가 연간 교육을 계획하는 상황이다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: CDTM 추가5시간은 협약의 실무영역과 일반적으로 관련되어야 한다. 무관한 CE로 추가시간을 전부 대체할 수 없다. B: 여러 clinical practice area의 추가 교육은 권고와 구별하며 정책은 총25시간만 요구한다고 명시한다. 협약 수마다 무조건5시간씩 법정 최소를 더하는 문장은 맞지 않는다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CDTM의 정책상 최소는 매년 일반20시간에 추가5시간, 총25시간이다. 여러 영역별 추가 교육 권고를 협약별 강제5시간으로 바꾸지 않았다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 직접 주사한 약사만 CE 대상이라는 주장은 직접 감독자도 명시한 정책과 다르다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CDTM 추가5시간은 협약의 실무영역과 일반적으로 관련되어야 한다. 무관한 CE로 추가시간을 전부 대체할 수 없다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 초기 immunizer 교육과 매년 유지 immunization CE는 별개다. 초기교육 완료가 후속 annual CE를 없애지 않는다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is preparing for renewal. In the first calendar year of the two-year renewal cycle, she completed 24 contact hours. In the second calendar year, she has completed 16 contact hours. Her pharmacy-law and home-study requirements are otherwise satisfied. What is the best way to address the remaining CE requirement?

choices.text: Renew now because the Board looks only at the combined 40-hour total for the two-year cycle.
Complete 4 more contact hours in the second calendar year because the 20-hour minimum applies to each calendar year.
Complete only additional pharmacy-law hours; the annual total no longer matters once the law requirement is met.
Ask the CE provider to redate 4 first-year credits so they count in the second calendar year.
Repeat all 20 second-year hours because completing more than 20 hours in the first year invalidates the surplus-year record.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist directly supervises vaccination but does not personally give injections. The pharmacist also practices under an active CDTM agreement.

Case B: The same pharmacist has two different CDTM clinical practice areas and asks how the additional annual-hours requirement is applied.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Unrelated CE can replace all of the agreement-related additional CDTM hours.
Each additional CDTM agreement automatically adds another mandatory five hours to the minimum.
Completing initial immunizer training eliminates subsequent annual immunization CE.
Direct supervision of immunizing activity triggers the policy's annual immunization CE requirement.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 임시 CSP 최종검수 업무에 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger를 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 유해약물이라는 단어만으로 sterile/nonsterile compounding credit이 자동 인정되지 않는다. 해당 compounding focus·제목 keyword 조건 또는 Board 검토 경로를 확인해야 한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Finished CSP의 최종 검수 및 임시 업무도 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger에 포함된다. 직접 재료를 혼합하지 않는다는 이유로 면제되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 해당 complex nonsterile CE는 연3시간이며 sterile5시간과 동일하지 않다.

original_explanation_review.learning_boundary_finding_ko: 동일family네문항은같은두사례와판단을공유하는연습변형이며네독립임상사례로세지않는다는전체boundary를읽었다. 이를법적근거나독립duplicate판정의대체로쓰지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 임시 CSP 최종검수 업무에 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger를 적용한다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 직접 혼합을 하지 않은 임시 검수 약사도 해당 교육 의무를 확인해야 하는 상황이다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: 유해약물이라는 단어만으로 sterile/nonsterile compounding credit이 자동 인정되지 않는다. 해당 compounding focus·제목 keyword 조건 또는 Board 검토 경로를 확인해야 한다. B: 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Compounding hours must always be added above the general annual 20 hours.
A generic USP 800 course is not automatically acceptable as the specified compounding CE.
The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.
Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.

Complex-nonsterile duties use the same five-hour requirement as sterile duties.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 직접 혼합뿐 아니라 감독·oversight·최종 검수도 sterile CE 대상이다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 해당 complex nonsterile CE는 연3시간이며 sterile5시간과 동일하지 않다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Sterile/nonsterile compounding에 특정하지 않은 일반 USP800 과정은 자동으로 compounding CE에 인정되지 않는다. 이는 CE 정책의 명시 기준이며 전체 USP800 문언 검증으로 주장하지 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: Complex nonsterile 검수 약사가 과정 제목·내용으로 specialized credit을 검토하는 상황이다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: 직접 혼합뿐 아니라 감독·oversight·최종 검수도 sterile CE 대상이다. B: 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Compounding hours must always be added above the general annual 20 hours.
A generic USP 800 course is not automatically acceptable as the specified compounding CE.
The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.
Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.

Complex-nonsterile duties use the same five-hour requirement as sterile duties.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. CSP5시간·complex CNSP3시간·일반20시간 산입·과정 특정성을 구별한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Finished CSP의 최종 검수 및 임시 업무도 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger에 포함된다. 직접 재료를 혼합하지 않는다는 이유로 면제되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 명시된 complex nonsterile 감독·조제·최종 검수 업무에는 매년3시간 요건이 적용된다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Sterile/nonsterile compounding에 특정하지 않은 일반 USP800 과정은 자동으로 compounding CE에 인정되지 않는다. 이는 CE 정책의 명시 기준이며 전체 USP800 문언 검증으로 주장하지 않는다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.
Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: INCORRECT 극성으로 compounding CE를 항상 일반20시간 위에 더한다는 주장을 고른다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. INCORRECT 극성으로 compounding CE를 항상 일반20시간 위에 더한다는 주장을 고른다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. Sterile/nonsterile compounding에 특정하지 않은 일반 USP800 과정은 자동으로 compounding CE에 인정되지 않는다. 이는 CE 정책의 명시 기준이며 전체 USP800 문언 검증으로 주장하지 않는다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 명시된 complex nonsterile 감독·조제·최종 검수 업무에는 매년3시간 요건이 적용된다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. Finished CSP의 최종 검수 및 임시 업무도 sterile CE 연5시간 trigger에 포함된다. 직접 재료를 혼합하지 않는다는 이유로 면제되지 않는다.

original_explanation_review.learning_boundary_finding_ko: 동일family네문항은같은두사례와판단을공유하는연습변형이며네독립임상사례로세지않는다는전체boundary를읽었다. 이를법적근거나독립duplicate판정의대체로쓰지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: INCORRECT 극성으로 compounding CE를 항상 일반20시간 위에 더한다는 주장을 고른다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.

criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: 적격 compounding CE는 매년 일반20시간에 산입 가능하다. 언제나20시간 위로 더해야 한다는 문장은 CDTM additional 구조와 혼동한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist directly oversees both sterile and complex nonsterile compounding. Which continuing-education statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Meet the applicable annual sterile-compounding CE requirement.
Use general pharmacy-law CE in place of all compounding CE.
Also assess the annual complex-nonsterile compounding CE requirement.
Apply compounding CE only to technicians.
Treat the applicable requirements as cumulative when both activities are supervised.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist only performs final verification of sterile preparations during a temporary assignment and does not physically compound them.

Case B: A pharmacist verifies complex nonsterile preparations and tries to count a general hazardous-drug course with no sterile or nonsterile compounding focus toward the specialized requirement.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Final verification of finished sterile preparations can trigger the five-hour annual sterile CE requirement.
The complex-nonsterile category requires three annual hours for the specified duties.
Compounding hours must always be added above the general annual 20 hours.
A generic USP 800 course is not automatically acceptable as the specified compounding CE.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. CPE Monitor에 보이지 않는 적격 CE의 이수증·증빙 보존을 판정한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Board-approved instructor의 동일 program credit은 연간 한 번 경로다. 같은 해 매번 반복 강의마다 새 credit을 받지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. CPE Monitor에 없는 적격 credit의 증빙도 유지해야 한다. 현재 정책의 non-ACPE/IPCE 증빙 조건 및 규정의 이수증 보존·audit 제출 의무가 뒷받침한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 갱신 승인만으로 CE 증빙을 즉시 폐기할 수 없다. 이수 후 기록 보존·Board 요청 제출 의무는 계속된다.

original_explanation_review.learning_boundary_finding_ko: 동일family네문항은같은두사례와판단을공유하는연습변형이며네독립임상사례로세지않는다는전체boundary를읽었다. 이를법적근거나독립duplicate판정의대체로쓰지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: CPE Monitor에 보이지 않는 적격 CE의 이수증·증빙 보존을 판정한다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 갱신 후 이수증을 폐기한 약사의 audit 준비 상태를 검토하는 실제 상황이다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: Board-approved instructor의 동일 program credit은 연간 한 번 경로다. 같은 해 매번 반복 강의마다 새 credit을 받지 않는다. C: 갱신 승인만으로 CE 증빙을 즉시 폐기할 수 없다. 이수 후 기록 보존·Board 요청 제출 의무는 계속된다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: 첫보기 “Each repeat presentation of the same program earns new instructor CE credit that year.”와마지막보기 “A payment receipt without activity or completion information is sufficient CE evidence.”를포함해 실제조건·면허·인정경로·예외를판정해야한다. CPE Monitor에 보이지 않는 적격 CE의 이수증·증빙 보존을 판정한다. Required/only같은단어,숫자,반복형식의존재만으로자동FAIL하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: CPE Monitor에 보이지 않는 적격 CE의 이수증·증빙 보존을 판정한다. 숫자하나의존재만으로trivia라고하지않고기산점·대안경로·자격/발급·의무/권고를사례에적용하는지를확인했다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 갱신 후 이수증을 폐기한 약사의 audit 준비 상태를 검토하는 실제 상황이다. 두사례의공통담당업무와별도법적판정을구별했다. 문항초점에서관련없는보기가정답단서가되는문제는wordingcriterion에따로기록했다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist teaches the same Board-approved continuing education program four times in one year and separately completes two courses in a postgraduate pharmacy curriculum. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: As a Board-approved instructor she receives credit for the program taught on a one-time basis annually.
She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacist has acceptable non-ACPE credits that do not appear in CPE Monitor and discards the course certificates after renewal.

Case B: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Credits absent from CPE Monitor require no evidence once renewal is accepted.
A payment receipt without activity or completion information is sufficient CE evidence.
The stated instructor-credit route allows credit once annually for that program.
Renewal approval authorizes immediate disposal of all supporting CE records.

Required documentation must be retained for acceptable credits not shown in CPE Monitor.

She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

Case B: An instructor teaches the same Board-approved CE program repeatedly in one year and requests a fresh instructor credit for every presentation.

Renewal approval authorizes immediate disposal of all supporting CE records.

choices.text: As a Board-approved instructor she receives credit for the program taught on a one-time basis annually.
She receives separate instructor credit for each of the four presentations.
Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.
Postgraduate course credit requires the sponsor or co-sponsor to be Board-authorized or ACPE-accredited.
Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem:

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

Postgraduate credit is available only for courses in pharmacy law.

Postgraduate credit requires the course to instruct in pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacy practice or pharmacy law.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy learns that a certified pharmacy technician's certification from the certifying body lapsed last week. The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence remains current. Which consequences follow? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The individual is limited to the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician.
The individual must use the title pharmacy technician.
The individual is counted as a pharmacy technician when calculating supervisory ratios.
The individual may no longer work in the pharmacy in any capacity.
The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence is automatically suspended.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A nationally certified technician moves to Massachusetts but has not yet obtained a Massachusetts technician license. The pharmacy schedules dispensing support work immediately.

Case B: A manager labels a licensed technician as a pharmacist intern because the technician plans to enter pharmacy school next year.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: National technician certification transfers final dispensing validation to the technician.
Intern duties require the applicable intern licensure rather than an employer-assigned title.
Current national certification permits technician practice before state licensure.
A trainee may work without any Board license until the training is finished.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy learns that a certified pharmacy technician's certification from the certifying body lapsed last week. The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence remains current. Which consequences follow? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The individual is limited to the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician.
The individual must use the title pharmacy technician.
The individual is counted as a pharmacy technician when calculating supervisory ratios.
The individual may no longer work in the pharmacy in any capacity.
The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence is automatically suspended.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A nationally certified technician moves to Massachusetts but has not yet obtained a Massachusetts technician license. The pharmacy schedules dispensing support work immediately.

Case B: A manager labels a licensed technician as a pharmacist intern because the technician plans to enter pharmacy school next year.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: National technician certification transfers final dispensing validation to the technician.
Intern duties require the applicable intern licensure rather than an employer-assigned title.
A trainee may work without any Board license until the training is finished.
Current national certification permits technician practice before state licensure.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: INCORRECT 극성으로 CPhT가 최종 dispensing validation을 맡는 해석을 고른다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. INCORRECT 극성으로 CPhT가 최종 dispensing validation을 맡는 해석을 고른다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. PTT는 별도로 면허를 받는 training category이며 연령·감독·전화수신·기간 제한이 있다. 일반 무면허 교육생으로 취급하지 않는다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. Intern 업무는 해당 MA intern licensure에 근거해야 한다. Employer-assigned title은 그 면허를 대신하지 않는다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 국가 인증만으로 최종 patient dispensing validation이 technician에게 넘어가지 않는다. Pharmacist의 최종 책임과 technician tier의 범위를 구별한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. National certification은 MA Board technician license를 대신하지 않는다. 인증은 적격 경로의 일부이며 주 면허를 실제 취득해야 한다.

original_explanation_review.learning_boundary_finding_ko: 동일family네문항은같은두사례와판단을공유하는연습변형이며네독립임상사례로세지않는다는전체boundary를읽었다. 이를법적근거나독립duplicate판정의대체로쓰지않았다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: Every option below involves gabapentin stock at an otherwise eligible Massachusetts hospital ADD. Which stocking actions are permitted under the current technician-stocking policy? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A nationally certified licensed technician uses the no-prior-pharmacist-verification Schedule VI shortcut for gabapentin.
A nationally certified licensed technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin under the ordinary supervised licensed-technician pathway.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads unverified gabapentin based only on a visual bottle check.
A pharmacy technician trainee loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using required electronic validation under pharmacist direction and supervision.
A licensed non-trainee pharmacy technician loads pharmacist-verified gabapentin using electronic validation under pharmacist supervision.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A nationally certified technician moves to Massachusetts but has not yet obtained a Massachusetts technician license. The pharmacy schedules dispensing support work immediately.

Case B: A manager labels a licensed technician as a pharmacist intern because the technician plans to enter pharmacy school next year.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: National technician certification transfers final dispensing validation to the technician.
Intern duties require the applicable intern licensure rather than an employer-assigned title.
A trainee may work without any Board license until the training is finished.
Current national certification permits technician practice before state licensure.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts preceptor is reviewing a candidate's internship record against the Board-approved internship requirement. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One pathway requires at least 1500 hours, of which at least 1000 are in a Board-approved pharmacy or pharmacy-related setting.
On that pathway at least 500 hours must be in clinical pharmacy, a demonstration project, manufacturing, or analytical or industrial pharmacy.
An alternative pathway is at least 1500 intern hours acquired through experiential pharmacy education for a graduate of an ACPE-accredited institution.
The Board may grant credit for out-of-state internship experience on appropriate documentation.
All 1500 hours must be acquired within a single calendar year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.

Case B: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Qualifying ACPE experiential education can satisfy the specified internship pathway.
A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacy student completes 12 hours of qualifying Massachusetts pharmacy-internship activity in one day. The student then remains at the site for a separate two-hour school seminar, and the preceptor proposes recording all 14 hours as Board internship credit. What should be recorded? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The preceptor should record no more than 12 qualifying internship hours for that day.
No more than 12 hours may be credited toward the pharmacy internship in one day.
The extra seminar may be documented separately as school activity, but it cannot increase that day's Board internship credit.
Combining internship work with separately documented educational activity does not raise the Board's maximum internship credit above 12 hours for that day.
All 14 hours may count as internship credit whenever the preceptor signs both the internship log and the seminar attendance record.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.

Case B: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Qualifying ACPE experiential education can satisfy the specified internship pathway.
A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts preceptor is reviewing a candidate's internship record against the Board-approved internship requirement. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: One pathway requires at least 1500 hours, of which at least 1000 are in a Board-approved pharmacy or pharmacy-related setting.
On that pathway at least 500 hours must be in clinical pharmacy, a demonstration project, manufacturing, or analytical or industrial pharmacy.
An alternative pathway is at least 1500 intern hours acquired through experiential pharmacy education for a graduate of an ACPE-accredited institution.
The Board may grant credit for out-of-state internship experience on appropriate documentation.
All 1500 hours must be acquired within a single calendar year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A pharmacy student begins a hospital rotation in Massachusetts without an intern license because the placement is arranged by an approved school.

Case B: An ACPE graduate has documented qualifying experiential hours and is told that all 1,500 hours must be repeated outside the degree program.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Every ACPE graduate must repeat 1,500 hours after graduation regardless of experiential credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacy student completes 12 hours of qualifying Massachusetts pharmacy-internship activity in one day. The student then remains at the site for a separate two-hour school seminar, and the preceptor proposes recording all 14 hours as Board internship credit. What should be recorded? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The preceptor should record no more than 12 qualifying internship hours for that day.
No more than 12 hours may be credited toward the pharmacy internship in one day.
The extra seminar may be documented separately as school activity, but it cannot increase that day's Board internship credit.
Combining internship work with separately documented educational activity does not raise the Board's maximum internship credit above 12 hours for that day.
All 14 hours may count as internship credit whenever the preceptor signs both the internship log and the seminar attendance record.

A 14-hour internship shift necessarily earns 14 hours of Board credit.
Any out-of-state employer's hour total is automatically accepted without evidence.
The Massachusetts intern license is required before the applicable internship begins, including hospital placements.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A PharmD graduate of an ACPE-accredited school has accepted a pharmacy residency at a Massachusetts hospital and will begin next month. She has not yet passed NAPLEX or MPJE. Which arrangement satisfies the regulation?

choices.text: She may practise on the strength of her residency appointment and PharmD degree.
She may practise unsupervised because a residency is a Board-approved training program.
She may practise only after obtaining a Massachusetts pharmacist licence.
She must hold a Massachusetts pharmacy intern licence and be supervised by a pharmacist.
She must hold an out-of-state licence recognised for reciprocity.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A graduate intern may perform independent final verification before pharmacist licensure.
An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
An out-of-state pharmacist license permits independent practice during the Massachusetts residency.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.

this_question_distinguishing_options: The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: An out-of-state pharmacist license permits independent practice during the Massachusetts residency.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A PharmD graduate of an ACPE-accredited school has accepted a pharmacy residency at a Massachusetts hospital and will begin next month. She has not yet passed NAPLEX or MPJE. Which arrangement satisfies the regulation?

choices.text: She may practise on the strength of her residency appointment and PharmD degree.
She may practise unsupervised because a residency is a Board-approved training program.
She may practise only after obtaining a Massachusetts pharmacist licence.
She must hold a Massachusetts pharmacy intern licence and be supervised by a pharmacist.
She must hold an out-of-state licence recognised for reciprocity.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
A graduate intern may perform independent final verification before pharmacist licensure.
The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.

Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.

Notice to the employer substitutes for the Board's program-withdrawal notice.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy intern withdraws from her PharmD program at the end of a semester. She plans to reapply next year and continues working shifts at the pharmacy. What does the regulation require of her?

choices.text: Nothing, because her intern licence remains valid until its expiration date.
Written notification to the Board within 14 days of the withdrawal.
Written notification to the Board within 30 days of the withdrawal.
Notification by her preceptor rather than by her.
Notification only if she does not reapply within one year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.
The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.

A.original_choice_text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. intern name tag는 intern의 이름과 pharmacy intern 표기를 포함해야 한다. pharmacist licensure를 기다리는 중에 pharmacist로 표시하지 않는다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 이 잘못된 설명이 선택 대상이다.

B.original_choice_text: Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.
B.finding_ko: 맞다. approved pharmacy school/PharmD program withdrawal일부터14일 안에 written Board notification을 해야 한다. 고용주 통지와 별도이다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 옳은 설명은 선택하지 않는다.

C.original_choice_text: The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
C.finding_ko: 맞다. MA residency의 PharmD graduate는 MA pharmacist license를 얻을 때까지 appropriate MA intern license와 pharmacist supervision 경로가 필요하다. 타주 pharmacist license만으로 독립 MA practice를 허용하지 않는다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 옳은 설명은 선택하지 않는다.

D.finding_ko: 맞다. 졸업 후 pharmacist license 전까지 계속 intern으로 acting할 수 있지만 intern scope/supervision과 final verification 제한은 유지된다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 옳은 설명은 선택하지 않는다.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: INCORRECT 극성으로 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 badge에 표시하는 해석을 고른다. 각 보기의 참/거짓에 질문 극성을 적용한 선택은 기존 키와 일치한다. 정책의한정·업무주체·예외·기산점·의무/권고및각해설의교정문을현재공식근거에대조했다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. INCORRECT 극성으로 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 badge에 표시하는 해석을 고른다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 명찰에 표시할 수 없다. Intern name tag는 이름과 pharmacy intern을 표시한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 승인 학교/PharmD 프로그램에서 withdrawal한 intern은14일 내 Board에 서면 통지해야 한다. Preceptor나 employer 통지와 구별한다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. MA pharmacist license를 기다리는 residency graduate는 적절한 MA intern status와 pharmacist supervision이 필요하다. 타 주 면허나 resident 직함 자체가 MA 독립 practice 권한을 만들지 않는다.
INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 졸업 자체는 아직 pharmacist로 발급되지 않은 intern 역할의 제한을 제거하지 않는다.

original_explanation_review.learning_boundary_finding_ko: 동일family네문항은같은두사례와판단을공유하는연습변형이며네독립임상사례로세지않는다는전체boundary를읽었다. 이를법적근거나독립duplicate판정의대체로쓰지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: INCORRECT 극성으로 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 badge에 표시하는 해석을 고른다. 단순업무명칭대신주체·요건·허용/의무/금지를적용한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: Resident의 실제 면허와 근무 명찰 표시를 맞추는 인사·업무 관리 상황이다. 실제학생/직원/약사의상태를주어진대로유지했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: A: 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 명찰에 표시할 수 없다. Intern name tag는 이름과 pharmacy intern을 표시한다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: 첫보기 “An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.”와마지막보기 “Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.”를포함해 실제조건·면허·인정경로·예외를판정해야한다. INCORRECT 극성으로 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 badge에 표시하는 해석을 고른다. Required/only같은단어,숫자,반복형식의존재만으로자동FAIL하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: INCORRECT 극성으로 미발급 pharmacist 지위를 badge에 표시하는 해석을 고른다. 숫자하나의존재만으로trivia라고하지않고기산점·대안경로·자격/발급·의무/권고를사례에적용하는지를확인했다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: Resident의 실제 면허와 근무 명찰 표시를 맞추는 인사·업무 관리 상황이다. 두사례의공통담당업무와별도법적판정을구별했다. 문항초점에서관련없는보기가정답단서가되는문제는wordingcriterion에따로기록했다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy intern withdraws from her PharmD program at the end of a semester. She plans to reapply next year and continues working shifts at the pharmacy. What does the regulation require of her?

choices.text: Nothing, because her intern licence remains valid until its expiration date.
Written notification to the Board within 14 days of the withdrawal.
Written notification to the Board within 30 days of the withdrawal.
Notification by her preceptor rather than by her.
Notification only if she does not reapply within one year.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A PharmD graduate with an out-of-state pharmacist license begins a Massachusetts residency before the Massachusetts pharmacist license is issued.

Case B: A licensed intern withdraws from a PharmD program but does not notify the Board because the pharmacy employer already knows.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: An intern awaiting pharmacist licensure should use a Pharmacist badge to avoid confusion.
Withdrawal from the program requires the stated written Board notice within 14 days.
The graduate needs the appropriate Massachusetts intern status and pharmacist supervision while awaiting pharmacist licensure.
Graduation does not remove the limitations of the person's current intern role.

A.original_choice_text: The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다.75%는 이 policy의 technician competency examination 기준이다. 이것이 다른 MPJE 시험의 raw-score formula를 정하는 조항은 아니다. 이 보고서는 MPJE의 별도 합격 수치나 채점식을 인증하지 않는다.

B.original_choice_text: A qualifying national examination supports a licensing pathway but does not itself issue the Board license.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist licensed by examination in another state seeks Massachusetts licensure by reciprocity. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The applicant must be in good standing in all states where the applicant holds a licence.
A passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
Documentation of internship experience in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01 is required.
The applicant may be required to appear personally before the Board.
Reciprocity waives the MPJE because the applicant already passed a jurisprudence examination elsewhere.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: An 18-year-old applicant passes a listed national technician examination and assumes that no Massachusetts licensing application is needed.

Case B: A pharmacy uses the employer-training pathway after 500 trainee-employment hours and plans a 20-question competency examination.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.
Passing a qualifying national examination automatically issues the state technician license.
The specified employer competency examination requires at least 50 questions and a 75% passing standard.
A promise to complete 500 trainee hours later satisfies the employer pathway now.

A 20-question employer test satisfies the stated competency-examination minimum.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A pharmacist licensed by examination in another state seeks Massachusetts licensure by reciprocity. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The applicant must be in good standing in all states where the applicant holds a licence.
A passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
Documentation of internship experience in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01 is required.
The applicant may be required to appear personally before the Board.
Reciprocity waives the MPJE because the applicant already passed a jurisprudence examination elsewhere.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: An 18-year-old applicant passes a listed national technician examination and assumes that no Massachusetts licensing application is needed.

Case B: A pharmacy uses the employer-training pathway after 500 trainee-employment hours and plans a 20-question competency examination.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A qualifying national examination supports a licensing pathway but does not itself issue the Board license.
The specified employer competency examination requires at least 50 questions and a 75% passing standard.
The employer pathway requires the specified trainee employment before its examination route.
The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.

this_question_distinguishing_options: The technician-examination percentage is not an MPJE raw-score passing formula.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.

A.original_choice_text: A qualifying national examination supports a licensing pathway but does not itself issue the Board license.
A.finding_ko: 맞다. listed national exam 통과는 further training/exam 없이 licensure를 apply할 수 있는 경로이지 license 발급 그 자체가 아니다. actual Board license가 필요하다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 옳은 설명은 선택하지 않는다.

B.original_choice_text: The specified employer competency examination requires at least 50 questions and a 75% passing standard.

C.original_choice_text: The employer pathway requires the specified trainee employment before its examination route.
C.finding_ko: 맞다. specified on-the-job route는 trainee employment 최소500시간을 먼저 완료한 뒤 employer-administered examination을 통과하는 경로이다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 옳은 설명은 선택하지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: The technician-examination 75% standard establishes the MPJE raw-score passing percentage.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다.75%는 이 policy의 technician competency examination 기준이다. 이것이 다른 MPJE 시험의 raw-score formula를 정하는 조항은 아니다. 이 보고서는 MPJE의 별도 합격 수치나 채점식을 인증하지 않는다. 이 문항은 INCORRECT를 고르므로 이 잘못된 설명이 선택 대상이다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: INCORRECT 문항에서는 명제의 참/거짓과 선택 극성을 반대로 적용했다. 적격 national exam 합격은 추가 training/exam 없이 MA licensure 신청 가능한 경로이지 면허의 자동 발급이 아니다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.

this_question_distinguishing_options: The ordinary ceiling is whichever occurs later: one year or 1,500 hours.
The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.

The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Training status permits an unlicensed start until the trainee reaches 500 hours.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.

The ordinary ceiling is whichever occurs later: one year or 1,500 hours.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A 16-year-old is hired as a pharmacy technician trainee. The supervisor asks whether training may begin before the Massachusetts trainee license is issued.

Case B: An adult trainee reaches the ordinary one-year limit before reaching 1,500 employment hours and has no applicable exception or extension.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Training status permits an unlicensed start until the trainee reaches 500 hours.
The ordinary duration ceiling is 1,500 hours or one year, whichever comes first, subject to specified exceptions.
A trainee may work under remote telephone availability instead of the required direct supervision.
The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.

this_question_distinguishing_options: The ordinary minimum age for the trainee category is 16.
A trainee needs the Board-issued trainee license before starting the applicable work.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: Training status permits an unlicensed start until the trainee reaches 500 hours.
The trainee category uses the same 18-year minimum as full technician licensure.

A.original_choice_text: Calling the prescriber makes clinical dose clarification permissible trainee work.
A.finding_ko: 틀리다. dose discrepancy의 clinical resolution과 drug-therapy clarification은 technician tier 업무가 아니다. 전화 업무이거나 routine처럼 보인다는 사실로 권한이 생기지 않는다.

B.original_choice_text: A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
B.finding_ko: 틀리다. trained designee의 offer to counsel 전달과 actual clinical counseling은 다르다. offer를 할 수 있어도 trainee가 독립 clinical counseling을 제공할 수 없다.

authority_evidence.version: Official CMR9 footer2024-12-06; original clause effective dates not individually established

C.original_choice_text: Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. permitted data entry는 telephone prescription acceptance 권한과 다르다. 역할별 verbal new/refill 수신 제한을 입력 능력으로 우회하지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.
D.finding_ko: 맞다. unchanged ScheduleIII–VI verbal refill을 request/accept하는 허용에서 PTT가 명시적으로 제외된다. no-new-drug라는 사실로 trainee에게 수신권한이 생기지 않는다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core및각distractor·교정문·boundary를모두읽었다. 변경 없는 verbal refill authorization 수신 허용에서도 PTT가 제외됨을 적용한다. 명시된범위에서지지되며미제시예외·자동면허·타시험채점공식을보태지않았다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Clinical dose discrepancy를 해결하는 것은 technician-tier 권한 밖이다. 전화라는 수단이나 routine이라는 판단이 임상 권한을 만들지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Offer to counsel 전달과 실제 임상 counseling은 다르다. Trainee의 offer 전달이 독립 counseling 권한이 되지 않는다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 허용된 전산 입력 보조는 전화처방을 적법하게 수신할 권한을 만들지 않는다. Typing과 prescription receiving을 구별한다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Clinical dose clarification remains outside technician-tier authority.
Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.

this_question_distinguishing_options: Calling the prescriber makes clinical dose clarification permissible trainee work.
The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.
nearest_public_distinguishing_options: Clinical dose clarification remains outside technician-tier authority.
An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.

A.original_choice_text: Clinical dose clarification remains outside technician-tier authority.
A.finding_ko: 맞다. clinical dose clarification은 ordinary/certified technicians의 범위를 벗어나 pharmacist가 처리해야 한다. 단순 factual communication/entry와 clinical judgment를 구분한다.

authority_evidence.version: Official CMR8 Register1546 dated2025-04-25;pages45/48.2 effective2025-01-09,pages46–48 corrected effective2018-04-06

B.original_choice_text: Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
B.finding_ko: 틀리다. permitted data entry는 telephone prescription acceptance 권한과 다르다. 역할별 verbal new/refill 수신 제한을 입력 능력으로 우회하지 않는다.

C.original_choice_text: A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
C.finding_ko: 틀리다. trained designee의 offer to counsel 전달과 actual clinical counseling은 다르다. offer를 할 수 있어도 trainee가 독립 clinical counseling을 제공할 수 없다.

authority_evidence.version: Official CMR9 footer2024-12-06; original clause effective dates not individually established

D.original_choice_text: An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.
D.finding_ko: 틀리다. unchanged refill이어도 PTT는 excluded category이다. 약물 변경이 없다는 사실만으로 금지된 telephone acceptance를 허용하지 않는다.

choice_explanations.finding_ko: 원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Clinical dose clarification·therapy modification은 technician tier가 수행할 수 없다. Pharmacist에게 넘겨야 하는 임상 업무다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. 허용된 전산 입력 보조는 전화처방을 적법하게 수신할 권한을 만들지 않는다. Typing과 prescription receiving을 구별한다.
원보기의 참/거짓과 해설의 교정문을 분리해 모두 읽었다. Offer to counsel 전달과 실제 임상 counseling은 다르다. Trainee의 offer 전달이 독립 counseling 권한이 되지 않는다.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Calling the prescriber makes clinical dose clarification permissible trainee work.
A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.

An unchanged refill may be received by a trainee because no new drug is ordered.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.
Typing a proposed telephone order grants authority to accept it as a prescription.
The trainee is excluded from the permitted unchanged verbal-refill authorization role.

original_read_snapshot.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician trainee working under the direct supervision of a pharmacist is asked to answer the pharmacy telephone during a staffing crunch and take a new prescription from a prescriber's agent. Which statement is correct?

choices.text: The trainee may take the prescription while under direct supervision.
The trainee may take the prescription if the pharmacist listens on a second handset.
The trainee may take the prescription if it is for a Schedule VI drug.
The trainee may not take prescriptions over the telephone.
The trainee may take the prescription after 500 hours of trainee employment.

original_read_snapshot.stem:
Case A: A prescriber calls with an unchanged refill authorization while the pharmacist is occupied. A technician trainee offers to receive the authorization.

Case B: A trainee is asked to telephone a prescriber and settle a dose discrepancy because the request seems routine.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Calling the prescriber makes clinical dose clarification permissible trainee work.
A trainee who can offer counseling may independently provide the clinical counseling.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy learns that a certified pharmacy technician's certification from the certifying body lapsed last week. The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence remains current. Which consequences follow? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The individual is limited to the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician.
The individual must use the title pharmacy technician.
The individual is counted as a pharmacy technician when calculating supervisory ratios.
The individual may no longer work in the pharmacy in any capacity.
The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence is automatically suspended.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expires. The technician continues using the CPhT title and is counted in a certified position for staffing.

Case B: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
The specified loss-of-certification reporting duty is separate from changing work assignments.
The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.
The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.

Case B: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The technician license expires on every even-numbered December 31.
A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts technician’s national certification expires on October 12, 2026. The Massachusetts technician license remains active. The technician tells the MOR the same day and plans to seek recertification. The pharmacy has not submitted a report to the Massachusetts Board.

Which steps are required by the cited certification-loss rules? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Keep the certified-technician title during a 14-day reporting grace period.
Report the loss of certification to the Board within 14 calendar days.
Treat the active Massachusetts technician license as automatically revoked.
Defer the Board report until the next Massachusetts technician-license renewal.
Use the pharmacy-technician title and category while certification is lapsed.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy learns that a certified pharmacy technician's certification from the certifying body lapsed last week. The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence remains current. Which consequences follow? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The individual is limited to the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician.
The individual must use the title pharmacy technician.
The individual is counted as a pharmacy technician when calculating supervisory ratios.
The individual may no longer work in the pharmacy in any capacity.
The individual's Board pharmacy technician licence is automatically suspended.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expires. The technician continues using the CPhT title and is counted in a certified position for staffing.

Case B: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
The specified loss-of-certification reporting duty is separate from changing work assignments.
The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.
The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.

Case B: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The technician license uses the stated biennial birthday-based expiration.
Renewal of national certification does not renew the state technician license.
A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
A lapse exceeding two years can involve additional Board conditions.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts technician’s national certification expires on October 12, 2026. The Massachusetts technician license remains active. The technician tells the MOR the same day and plans to seek recertification. The pharmacy has not submitted a report to the Massachusetts Board.

Which steps are required by the cited certification-loss rules? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Keep the certified-technician title during a 14-day reporting grace period.
Report the loss of certification to the Board within 14 calendar days.
Treat the active Massachusetts technician license as automatically revoked.
Defer the Board report until the next Massachusetts technician-license renewal.
Use the pharmacy-technician title and category while certification is lapsed.

A.original_option_text: A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
A.finding_ko: 국가 인증 lapse는 유효한 주 PT면허의 자동 revocation이 아니다. 인증 lapse 중 적용할 PT 업무·명칭·감독비율을 바꾸는 별도 요건이다.

B.original_option_text: The specified loss-of-certification reporting duty is separate from changing work assignments.
B.finding_ko: 인증 상실의 Board 보고는 업무·직함·감독비율을 ordinary PT 범위로 조정하는 의무와 별도로 충족해야 한다. 보고는 pharmacy와 개인 licensee에 적용되며 해당 규정은 14 calendar days이다.

C.original_option_text: The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.
C.finding_ko: 국가 인증 lapse 중에는 ordinary PT의 허용 업무와 pharmacy technician 명칭을 사용해야 한다. 유효한 주 면허가 있다고 CPhT 추가 권한이 유지되는 것은 아니다.

D.original_option_text: The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.
D.finding_ko: 인증 lapse 시 감독비율 계산에서 PT로 계산한다. 현재 실제 자격이 기준이며 과거 인증 이력을 계속 certified 자리로 셀 수 없다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy has just learned that a staff member's technician certification lapsed. The staff member continues to wear a name tag reading Certified Pharmacy Technician while the pharmacy sorts out the paperwork. What should the pharmacy do about the name tag?

choices.text: Change the tag to read Pharmacy Technician.
Leave the tag unchanged until the certification is restored.
Remove the name tag entirely until the certification is restored.
Change the tag to read Pharmacy Technician Trainee.
Leave the tag unchanged if the pharmacist on duty documents the lapse.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expires. The technician continues using the CPhT title and is counted in a certified position for staffing.

Case B: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

Which statements accurately apply to the described cases or the related requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
The specified loss-of-certification reporting duty is separate from changing work assignments.
The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.
The technician must be treated within the ordinary technician duties and title while certification is lapsed.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.

Case B: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

Which proposed interpretation is INCORRECT? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A lapse exceeding two years can involve additional Board conditions.
A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
The technician license uses the stated biennial birthday-based expiration.
Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts technician’s national certification expires on October 12, 2026. The Massachusetts technician license remains active. The technician tells the MOR the same day and plans to seek recertification. The pharmacy has not submitted a report to the Massachusetts Board.

Which steps are required by the cited certification-loss rules? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: Keep the certified-technician title during a 14-day reporting grace period.
Report the loss of certification to the Board within 14 calendar days.
Treat the active Massachusetts technician license as automatically revoked.
Defer the Board report until the next Massachusetts technician-license renewal.
Use the pharmacy-technician title and category while certification is lapsed.

A.original_option_text: A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
A.finding_ko: 2년 초과 면허 lapse의 갱신에는 Board가 정한 추가 조건이 붙을 수 있다. 고용주 competency sign-off만으로 신청·수수료·Board 조건을 대체하지 못한다.

B.original_option_text: The technician license uses the stated biennial birthday-based expiration.
B.finding_ko: PT면허는 licensee 생일을 기준으로 2년마다 만료한다. 약사의 December31 주기를 PT면허에 옮겨 적용하지 않는다.

C.original_option_text: Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.

D.original_option_text: Submitting a late renewal automatically creates a temporary practice extension.
D.finding_ko: 만료 후 갱신을 신청했다는 사실만으로 임시 업무 연장이 생기지 않는다. 규정상 만료 후 PT업무는 무면허 업무가 될 수 있다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician's license has been expired for 26 months. The technician submits the renewal form and fees, but the Board has not renewed the license or decided whether to impose additional conditions. The pharmacy wants the technician to begin work under direct pharmacist supervision. Which statement is most accurate?

choices.text: Submitting the form and fees restores the license provisionally while the Board reviews the application.
Direct pharmacist supervision may permit practice during the renewal review despite the expired license.
A lapse exceeding two years automatically requires a specified national technician examination before renewal.
The technician cannot practice until renewal; because the lapse exceeded two years, additional Board conditions may apply.
A lapse exceeding two years permanently bars renewal of the technician license.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.

Case B: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The technician license expires on every even-numbered December 31.
A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician's Massachusetts license remains active, but national certification expires. The technician continues using the CPhT title and is counted in a certified position for staffing.

Case B: The manager says no action is needed until the state technician license expires because national certification is a separate credential.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Changing work assignments eliminates any separate certification-loss report.
An active state license preserves every certified-technician duty after certification lapses.
A lapsed national certificate automatically makes the active state license a revoked license.
The lapse changes the qualified category used in the supervisory-ratio calculation.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A technician returns to Massachusetts after a career break. The state technician license expired more than two years ago, but national certification is current. The technician asks whether the pharmacist rule requiring MPJE after a long lapse automatically applies to a technician.

Which statement accurately describes the technician’s renewal rule? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: MPJE is automatically required whenever any pharmacy-related license lapses for two years.
Current national certification authorizes work while the state renewal application is processed.
An employer’s competency sign-off removes additional Board conditions for this lapse.
The Board may impose additional conditions; the technician rule does not itself mandate MPJE.

A.original_option_text: The technician license expires on every even-numbered December 31.
A.finding_ko: PT면허의 만료 기준은 2년마다 본인 생일이다. 모든 PT면허가 짝수연도 December31에 만료한다는 설명은 틀리다.

B.original_option_text: A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
B.finding_ko: 2년 초과 면허 lapse의 갱신에는 Board가 정한 추가 조건이 붙을 수 있다. 고용주 competency sign-off만으로 신청·수수료·Board 조건을 대체하지 못한다.

C.original_option_text: A pending late renewal does not itself authorize practice under an expired license.
C.finding_ko: 늦은 갱신 신청이 pending이라는 이유만으로 만료 면허하의 practice를 허용하지 않는다. 실제 면허 유효성을 회복해야 한다.

D.original_option_text: Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.
D.finding_ko: 국가 인증과 Massachusetts PT면허는 별개이다. 국가 인증 갱신료 납부가 주 면허 갱신 신청·수수료를 대신하지 않는다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy technician's license has been expired for 26 months. The technician submits the renewal form and fees, but the Board has not renewed the license or decided whether to impose additional conditions. The pharmacy wants the technician to begin work under direct pharmacist supervision. Which statement is most accurate?

choices.text: Submitting the form and fees restores the license provisionally while the Board reviews the application.
Direct pharmacist supervision may permit practice during the renewal review despite the expired license.
A lapse exceeding two years automatically requires a specified national technician examination before renewal.
The technician cannot practice until renewal; because the lapse exceeded two years, additional Board conditions may apply.
A lapse exceeding two years permanently bars renewal of the technician license.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
Case A: A technician assumes that the Massachusetts license expires on the same December 31 cycle as the pharmacists in the pharmacy.

Case B: A technician sends a late renewal application after the birthday-based expiration and asks to continue working while it is processed.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A lapse exceeding two years is resolved solely by an employer competency sign-off.
The technician license uses the stated biennial birthday-based expiration.
Paying the national-certification renewal fee also renews the state technician license.
Submitting a late renewal automatically creates a temporary practice extension.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
The compliance calendar has a row for a Massachusetts pharmacy technician license. The manager must use that license’s ordinary expiration cycle, not the renewal date of another credential.

Which calendar entry matches this credential? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The licensee’s birthdate in its two-year renewal cycle
December 31 of the even-numbered renewal year
December 31 every year
December 31 of the odd-numbered renewal year

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A technician returns to Massachusetts after a career break. The state technician license expired more than two years ago, but national certification is current. The technician asks whether the pharmacist rule requiring MPJE after a long lapse automatically applies to a technician.

Which statement accurately describes the technician’s renewal rule? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: MPJE is automatically required whenever any pharmacy-related license lapses for two years.
Current national certification authorizes work while the state renewal application is processed.
An employer’s competency sign-off removes additional Board conditions for this lapse.
The Board may impose additional conditions; the technician rule does not itself mandate MPJE.
