A.original_option_text: A pharmacist waits for the next routine progress report after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.
A.finding_ko: 응급실 추가 모니터링이 필요한 투약 반응은 즉시 처방자 보고 대상이다. 다음 통상 경과 보고까지 미루는 처리는 틀리다.

B.original_option_text: A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.
B.finding_ko: 적격 LA buprenorphine 주사는 제품별 표시·REMS를 따라야 한다. 예를 들어 SUBLOCADE는 SC 및 직접 의료인 전달·투약 제한을 갖는다. 모든 제품을 동일 용량·동일 제형으로 보는 주장은 아니다.
B.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 p3 Manufacturers’ Instructions;247 CMR 9.01(21);DailyMed SUBLOCADE §§2.1,5.2

C.original_option_text: A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
C.finding_ko: Circular은 IV 투약을 제외하고 ceftriaxone은 IM으로 명시한다. IM 허용을 IV 투약 권한으로 바꿀 수 없다.
C.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 p2 Dispensing by Administration(c),Eligible Medications; p3 Manufacturers’ Instructions

D.original_option_text: A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.
D.finding_ko: 훈련받고 현행 CPR을 갖춘 약사가 유효 처방하에 적격 성인에게 단회용 허용 LAI를 제품 요건에 맞게 투약할 수 있다. 나머지 교육·기록·공간 등 조건도 충족한다는 전제이다.
D.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 pp1–2 Dispensing by Administration; p3 Training/CPR/Manufacturers’ Instructions

E.original_option_text: A certified technician uses this non-vaccine administration circular to give an adult patient a long-acting antipsychotic injection.
E.finding_ko: 이 비백신 circular이 권한을 주는 인력은 약사와 intern이다. 인증 PT가 이를 근거로 성인 LAI antipsychotic을 투여하는 것은 지원되지 않는다.

criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는투여route와제품REMS/인력범위의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist waits for the next routine progress report after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.”와E“A certified technician uses this non-vaccine administration circular to give an adult patient a long-acting antipsychotic injection.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist administers an eligible patient-specific long-acting antipsychotic under the current MH/SUD pathway. Which workflow principles are consistent with the guidance? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Send the administration record to the prescriber as soon after administration as practical, as strongly encouraged by DCP guidance
Allow a cashier to perform the injection after the pharmacist verifies the prescription
Skip privacy protections because the medication treats mental illness
Use a prescribed single dose supplied in eligible single-dose packaging
Document the administration in the pharmacy's patient record

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts retail pharmacy offers medication administration under DCP 26-03-124. The cases do not involve a hospital privilege or a separately authorized opioid treatment program. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist uses the authority to administer a prescribed HIV-prevention injection as the basis for independently prescribing that injection.
A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.
A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.
A qualified intern administers an eligible adult patient’s IM medication under appropriate pharmacist supervision.

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist uses the authority to administer a prescribed HIV-prevention injection as the basis for independently prescribing that injection.
A.finding_ko: HIV 예방 주사를 투여할 수 있다는 사실 자체는 그 약을 독립 처방하는 근거가 아니다. 별도의 약사 처방 지침과 해당 요법 프로토콜의 충족을 확인해야 한다.

B.original_option_text: A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.
B.finding_ko: 훈련받고 현행 CPR을 갖춘 약사가 유효 처방하에 적격 성인에게 단회용 허용 LAI를 제품 요건에 맞게 투약할 수 있다. 나머지 교육·기록·공간 등 조건도 충족한다는 전제이다.
B.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 pp1–2 Dispensing by Administration; p3 Training/CPR/Manufacturers’ Instructions

C.original_option_text: A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
C.finding_ko: Circular은 IV 투약을 제외하고 ceftriaxone은 IM으로 명시한다. IM 허용을 IV 투약 권한으로 바꿀 수 없다.
C.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 p2 Dispensing by Administration(c),Eligible Medications; p3 Manufacturers’ Instructions

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.
D.finding_ko: 반응으로 병원·응급실의 추가 치료·검사·모니터링이 필요해졌으면 처방자에게 즉시 보고해야 한다. 입원 여부나 다음 정기 보고까지 기다리는 문제가 아니다.

E.original_option_text: A qualified intern administers an eligible adult patient’s IM medication under appropriate pharmacist supervision.
E.finding_ko: 적절한 감독하의 적격 intern은 circular의 조건을 충족하는 성인 환자의 허용 IM 약물을 투여할 수 있다. PT의 백신 권한과 혼동하지 않는다.
E.exact_authority: DCP 26-03-124 pp1–2 Dispensing by Administration;MA Policy 2020-15 II

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(투여 circular은 valid prescription을 전제로 한 administration 권한이다. HIV 처방 경로는 별도 guidance를 가리키므로 이 권한 자체가 독립 prescribing 근거가 되지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은투여route와제품REMS/인력범위을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist uses the authority to administer a prescribed HIV-prevention injection as the basis for independently prescribing that injection.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A trained pharmacist with current CPR administers an eligible single-dose LAI to an adult under a valid prescription and product requirements.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는투여route와제품REMS/인력범위의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면성인LAI/SC·IM, 인력범위와 ED반응통지의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist administers an eligible patient-specific long-acting antipsychotic under the current MH/SUD pathway. Which workflow principles are consistent with the guidance? Select all that apply.

Document the administration in the pharmacy's patient record

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist administers an eligible patient-specific long-acting antipsychotic under the current MH/SUD pathway. Which workflow principles are consistent with the guidance? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Send the administration record to the prescriber as soon after administration as practical, as strongly encouraged by DCP guidance
Allow a cashier to perform the injection after the pharmacist verifies the prescription
Skip privacy protections because the medication treats mental illness
Use a prescribed single dose supplied in eligible single-dose packaging
Document the administration in the pharmacy's patient record

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts retail pharmacy offers medication administration under DCP 26-03-124. The cases do not involve a hospital privilege or a separately authorized opioid treatment program. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacy administers ceftriaxone intravenously using the circular’s IM authorization.
A pharmacist distinguishes administering a prescribed HIV-prevention medication from independently prescribing every prevention regimen.
A pharmacist follows labeling and applicable REMS for an eligible long-acting buprenorphine injection.
A pharmacist uses an eligible product in single-dose packaging prescribed in single doses, with authorized refills as applicable.
A pharmacist immediately informs the prescriber after an administration reaction requiring emergency-department monitoring.

A.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Retail/community CPA 라도 Schedule II–V prescribing 제한을 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. 올바른 처리: A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. retail CDTM의 II–V 처방금지는 CPA에 약을 추가하는 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. alprazolam은 연방 IV이며 여기서 별도 주 전역 처방 경로를 사용하는 것도 아니다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core의각법률명제를per-choice참조조문과대조했다.일반정의·허용행위·필수기록/통지및제품scope를구분하고확인되지않은추가조건을보충하지않았다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Retail CDTM은 Schedule II–V prescribing을 허용하지 않는다. Alprazolam은 연방IV이며 CPA에 추가해도 제한이 없어지지 않는다.
종료 전 uninterrupted continuation을 마련하고 종료/비갱신 시 written patient notice를 제공해야 한다. 환자에게 알리지 않고 끝내는 처리는 부합하지 않는다.
Community CDTM의 환자는18세 이상이다. 별도 hormonal contraception의 any-person 경로가 retail CDTM 연령을 지우지 않는다.
Retail에서는 supervising physician의 개별 written referral과 primary/secondary diagnosis 정보가 필요하다. 단순 store 신청과 다르다.
초기 Rx 또는 modification/discontinuation의 copy는 발행24시간 안에 physician에게 보내며 urgent 상황은 더 빠르다. 2년 CPA 갱신 때까지 미룰 수 없다.

original_explanation_review.boundary_assessment_ko: 9개변형/모델별한문항이라는교육경계를읽었다.그선언을실제distinctness나법규근거로대체하지않고currentdefault0과실제nearest원문을별도로대조했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Retail CDTM은 Schedule II–V prescribing을 허용하지 않는다. Alprazolam은 연방IV이며 CPA에 추가해도 제한이 없어지지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제D의행위는A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“The parties terminate the collaboration without informing patients who still depend on its prescribing and monitoring.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는개별referral와retailprescribing조건의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A pharmacist waits until the CPA’s next biennial review to communicate an initial prescription or therapy change.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

author_review_blocker: 이번 저자 범위에서 조치가 필요한 법적·키·해설 결함을 발견하지 못했다. 독립 법률/현실성 감사나 공개 승인은 미실행이다.

A.original_choice_text: A new PharmD graduate seeks an applicable experience or Board-equivalency pathway before assuming CDTM eligibility.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. 과거 날짜가 붙은 PharmD grandfather 경로를 새 졸업자에게 무조건 적용하지 않는다. 현재 경험·equivalency 요건이 남는다.
A.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 해당 교육·경험·Board 판단 경로를 실제로 확인하는 행위는 타당하다. 다만 현행 법문(b)(3)은 PharmD 또는5년/동등을, 규정16.02(1)(c)는2017년 CPA 예외를 적어 적용관계가 다르다. 신졸업자에게 반드시 특정 추가 경로가 필요하다는 원해설의 무조건적 단정은 HOLD로 남긴다.

B.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. Retail/community CPA 라도 Schedule II–V prescribing 제한을 계약으로 없앨 수 없다.
B.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 성인·감독 의사 환자 의뢰·서명 CPA·허용 VI 범위 및 기타 요건을 충족한다는 원문이다. VI 권한도 의뢰에 지정한 진단/처방 지침 범위에 한정하며 모든 VI의 무제한 권한은 아니다.

C.original_choice_text: A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. CDTM 의 drug-related test evaluation 와 독립 diagnosis 범위는 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 법문(a)는 약물치료와 직접 관련된 검사 평가를 감독/직접 협의 및 프로토콜 아래 허용하면서 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 제한 없는 새로운 독립 진단권이 아니다.

D.original_choice_text: A qualified pharmacist treats any employer general-liability policy as sufficient without checking drug-therapy-management coverage.
D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. CPA 기간 중 해당 drug-therapy-management 를 보장하는 professional liability coverage 를 확인한다. 올바른 처리: A qualified pharmacist maintains insurance specifically covering drug-therapy management at at least $1 million per occurrence.
D.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 16.02(1)(b)는 CPA 기간 중 drug therapy management를 구체적으로 보장하는 건당 최소100만달러의 전문배상 보험을 요구한다. 일반 회사 보험이 있다는 사실만으로 충족을 가정할 수 없다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: An authorized pharmacist practising collaborative drug therapy management in a Massachusetts community pharmacy is asked during an inspection to produce the collaborative practice documents. Which statements about what this pharmacist is required to hold are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist must hold the signed original rather than a copy.
A copy of the current collaborative practice agreement must be maintained.
Copies of the current patient referral and patient consent must be included.
The documents must be maintained in the primary practice setting.
The documents must be readily retrievable when they are requested.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A qualified pharmacist treats any employer general-liability policy as sufficient without checking drug-therapy-management coverage.

C.original_choice_text: A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 과거 날짜가 붙은 PharmD grandfather 경로를 새 졸업자에게 무조건 적용하지 않는다. 현재 경험·equivalency 요건이 남는다. 올바른 처리: A new PharmD graduate seeks an applicable experience or Board-equivalency pathway before assuming CDTM eligibility.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 규정의 날짜 예외는2017-06-30 당일 또는 이전 CPA를 체결한 PharmD에 붙으므로 새 졸업자의 새 계약에 그 grandfather 사실을 꾸며 적용할 수 없다. 다만 법문(b)(3)의 별도 PharmD 문구와 규정의 적용관계는 해결하지 않았으며 원해설의 일반적 추가경험 필수 단정을 검증 완료로 세지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: A qualified pharmacist treats any employer general-liability policy as sufficient without checking drug-therapy-management coverage.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(성인 개별 referral, signed CPA와 허가된 Schedule VI/지정 diagnosis 범위의 관리는 지지된다. II–V prescribing 권한까지 포함하지 않는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답C=A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제D의문장“A qualified pharmacist treats any employer general-liability policy as sufficient without checking drug-therapy-management coverage.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는개별referral와retailprescribing조건의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

author_review_blocker: PharmD 자격의 법문§24B½(b)(3)과247CMR16.02(1)(c)의 현행 적용관계가 미해결이다. 원해설의 모든 신졸업자에게 추가경험/동등 경로가 필수라는 일반화는 검증 완료로 세지 않는다. Grandfather 날짜 자체의 오답과 확인을 구하는 행위는 좁게 지지된다.

A.original_choice_text: The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. CPA 종료/비갱신에는 환자 통지와 치료 지속 계획이 필요하다.
A.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 16.04(5)의 중단 없는 약물치료 계획과 환자 서면 통지를 수행하는 처리다. 통지를 더 일찍 하는 행위는 지지되지만 법정 별도 사전 일수를 이 보기에서 새로 추론하지 않는다.

B.original_choice_text: A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 과거 날짜가 붙은 PharmD grandfather 경로를 새 졸업자에게 무조건 적용하지 않는다. 현재 경험·equivalency 요건이 남는다. 올바른 처리: A new PharmD graduate seeks an applicable experience or Board-equivalency pathway before assuming CDTM eligibility.
B.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 규정의 날짜 예외는2017-06-30 당일 또는 이전 CPA를 체결한 PharmD에 붙으므로 새 졸업자의 새 계약에 그 grandfather 사실을 꾸며 적용할 수 없다. 다만 법문(b)(3)의 별도 PharmD 문구와 규정의 적용관계는 해결하지 않았으며 원해설의 일반적 추가경험 필수 단정을 검증 완료로 세지 않는다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 종료 전 치료 연속성 계획과 written notice를 마련하는 행위는 지지된다. 조문은 연속성은 prior to termination, written notice는 when terminated로 구분하므로 advance written notice만이 유일한 법정 시점이라고 단정하지 않는다.
보기의허용행위/특정grandfather경로판정은위와같다. 그러나해설의현재경험·equivalency가반드시필요하다는일반단정은MGL112§24B½(b)(3)/243CMR2.12(2)(c)의degree대안과247CMR16.02의제한관계가미해소이므로HOLD한다.
Retail CDTM 자체의 환자연령18세 이상을 확인한다. 별도 prescribing 제도를 혼합하지 않는다.
승인된 protocol과 physician supervision/direct consultation 아래 drug therapy에 직접 관련된 laboratory monitoring을 명시하고 diagnostic component를 부여하지 않는 범위가 CDTM 정의에 맞는다.
CPA는 pharmacist와 supervising physician이 적어도2년마다 review/renew한다. 환자별24시간 copy와 서로 다른 주기다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is evaluating the current statutory qualifications to enter a collaborative practice agreement. Which statements reflect M.G.L. c.112, § 24B1/2(b)? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Hold a current Massachusetts pharmacist license, currently practice in the Commonwealth, and maintain at least $1,000,000 of professional liability insurance.
Have earned a PharmD degree or completed five years of experience as a licensed pharmacist, or the equivalent.
Devote a portion of practice to the defined drug-therapy area and complete at least five additional related CE contact hours in each agreement year.
Apply for the statute's limited MassHealth ordering/referring participation if implementing regulations governing that participation are promulgated.
A pharmacist with a current PharmD must also complete five years of licensed-practice experience because the degree alternative is no longer recognized by statute.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.

author_review_blocker: PharmD 자격의 법문§24B½(b)(3)과247CMR16.02(1)(c)의 현행 적용관계가 미해결이다. 원해설의 모든 신졸업자에게 추가경험/동등 경로가 필수라는 일반화는 검증 완료로 세지 않는다. Grandfather 날짜 자체의 오답과 확인을 구하는 행위는 좁게 지지된다.

A.original_choice_text: The pharmacist treats the CPA as permanent after initial signatures and performs no later renewal.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. CPA 는 적어도 2 년마다 review/renew 한다. 초기 서명은 무기한 갱신 면제가 아니다. 올바른 처리: The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 16.04(4)의 최소2년 검토·갱신이 남는다. 최초 서명을 영구 CPA로 취급하고 이후 갱신을 전혀 하지 않는 것은 맞지 않는다.

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist communicates an initial prescription or therapy change to the supervising physician within 24 hours, sooner if urgent.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. Patient action 별 24 시간 communication 과 CPA 의 2 년 review/renewal 는 별개이다.
B.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 16.03(5)(e)2의24시간·긴급시 조기 통지에 맞는 방향이다. 필요한 것은 처방/변경/중단 사본 전달 및 진료기록도 포함하며, 원문의 다른 전제 충족을 그 요건 생략 허가로 읽지 않는다.

C.original_choice_text: A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 과거 날짜가 붙은 PharmD grandfather 경로를 새 졸업자에게 무조건 적용하지 않는다. 현재 경험·equivalency 요건이 남는다. 올바른 처리: A new PharmD graduate seeks an applicable experience or Board-equivalency pathway before assuming CDTM eligibility.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 규정의 날짜 예외는2017-06-30 당일 또는 이전 CPA를 체결한 PharmD에 붙으므로 새 졸업자의 새 계약에 그 grandfather 사실을 꾸며 적용할 수 없다. 다만 법문(b)(3)의 별도 PharmD 문구와 규정의 적용관계는 해결하지 않았으며 원해설의 일반적 추가경험 필수 단정을 검증 완료로 세지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Retail/community CPA 라도 Schedule II–V prescribing 제한을 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. 올바른 처리: A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
D.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. retail CDTM의 II–V 처방금지는 CPA에 약을 추가하는 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. alprazolam은 연방 IV이며 여기서 별도 주 전역 처방 경로를 사용하는 것도 아니다.

E.original_choice_text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
E.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Consent·referral 의 원본/사본 보관 및 전달 경로가 있다. 말로 확인했다는 사실만으로 기록 요건을 대체하지 않는다. 올바른 처리: The physician retains the original consent record and the pharmacist receives and retains the required copy.
E.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 16.03(5)(d)와16.04(6)은 환자별 의뢰·서면 동의 기록의 의사 원본 및 약사 사본 보관을 요구한다. 구두로 동의가 있다고 한 진술은 필요한 기록을 대체하지 못한다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A retail collaborative practice agreement expressly allows initial Schedule VI prescriptions. The supervising physician referred an adult patient with hypertension, and the collaborating pharmacist issues an authorized Schedule VI antihypertensive prescription for that referred diagnosis late Friday afternoon. The physician's office will not reopen until Monday. What should the pharmacist do next?

choices.text: Arrange to send a copy of the prescription to the supervising physician within 24 hours rather than waiting for the office to reopen.
Wait until Monday because the 24-hour copy requirement excludes weekends and holidays.
Keep the prescription only in the pharmacy's collaborative-practice file unless the supervising physician later requests a copy.
Send the prescription copy to the Board within 24 hours and provide it to the supervising physician at the next scheduled review.
No copy is required because the agreement already authorizes initial Schedule VI prescribing for the referred diagnosis.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(승인된 protocol과 physician supervision/direct consultation 아래 drug therapy에 직접 관련된 laboratory monitoring을 명시하고 diagnostic component를 부여하지 않는 범위가 CDTM 정의에 맞는다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제E의문장“A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는개별referral와retailprescribing조건의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts supervising physician refers a patient for collaborative drug therapy management, records the referral and the patient's consent in his own chart, and tells the collaborating pharmacist that the documentation is complete and nothing further is needed. Where must the individual referral and consent be recorded?

choices.text: In the supervising physician's record alone, which is what the statute requires.
In the pharmacist's record alone, since the pharmacist delivers the service.
In whichever of the two records the professionals agree should hold them.
In the patient's record, by the pharmacist and by the supervising physician.
In a register filed with the Board, separately from the patient's record.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A new PharmD graduate uses the pre-June-2017 grandfather provision as automatic qualification for a newly created agreement.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A pharmacist waits until the CPA’s next biennial review to communicate an initial prescription or therapy change.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

author_review_blocker: PharmD 자격의 법문§24B½(b)(3)과247CMR16.02(1)(c)의 현행 적용관계가 미해결이다. 원해설의 모든 신졸업자에게 추가경험/동등 경로가 필수라는 일반화는 검증 완료로 세지 않는다. Grandfather 날짜 자체의 오답과 확인을 구하는 행위는 좁게 지지된다.

A.original_choice_text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Consent·referral 의 원본/사본 보관 및 전달 경로가 있다. 말로 확인했다는 사실만으로 기록 요건을 대체하지 않는다. 올바른 처리: The physician retains the original consent record and the pharmacist receives and retains the required copy.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 16.03(5)(d)와16.04(6)은 환자별 의뢰·서면 동의 기록의 의사 원본 및 약사 사본 보관을 요구한다. 구두로 동의가 있다고 한 진술은 필요한 기록을 대체하지 못한다.

B.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. Retail/community CPA 라도 Schedule II–V prescribing 제한을 계약으로 없앨 수 없다.
B.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 성인·감독 의사 환자 의뢰·서명 CPA·허용 VI 범위 및 기타 요건을 충족한다는 원문이다. VI 권한도 의뢰에 지정한 진단/처방 지침 범위에 한정하며 모든 VI의 무제한 권한은 아니다.

C.original_choice_text: A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. CDTM 의 drug-related test evaluation 와 독립 diagnosis 범위는 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 법문(a)는 약물치료와 직접 관련된 검사 평가를 감독/직접 협의 및 프로토콜 아래 허용하면서 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 제한 없는 새로운 독립 진단권이 아니다.

D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. CPA 종료/비갱신에는 환자 통지와 치료 지속 계획이 필요하다.
D.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 16.04(5)의 중단 없는 약물치료 계획과 환자 서면 통지를 수행하는 처리다. 통지를 더 일찍 하는 행위는 지지되지만 법정 별도 사전 일수를 이 보기에서 새로 추론하지 않는다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A community pharmacy receives an individually signed referral for a patient to enter a collaborative drug therapy management program. The document lists the patient's name and address, primary diagnosis, authorized comorbid diagnoses, and detailed treatment instructions. It does not state the patient's known allergies and contains no statement that the patient gave written informed consent. The pharmacist notes that the affiliated hospital often begins inpatient collaborative management through a consultation request that does not contain those two items. What is the best conclusion for the community-pharmacy referral?

choices.text: It is sufficient because a signed referral and specific treatment instructions replace the need for allergy and consent information.
It is sufficient if the hospital's consultation process would accept the same document.
It is incomplete because a community CDTM referral must include known allergies and a statement of written informed consent, in addition to the other required patient-specific information.
It is incomplete only if the patient has a known allergy that would change the treatment instructions.
It may be completed by treating the hospital's consultation request as an incorporated attachment, even though that request contains neither missing item.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.
A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
The physician retains the original consent record and the pharmacist receives and retains the required copy.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: 모든선택지의주체·행위·조건·예외를새공식원문과대조했고현재key와일치한다.해설은해당좁은범위에서지지된다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core의각법률명제를per-choice참조조문과대조했다.일반정의·허용행위·필수기록/통지및제품scope를구분하고확인되지않은추가조건을보충하지않았다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Retail에서는 supervising physician의 개별 written referral과 primary/secondary diagnosis 정보가 필요하다. 단순 store 신청과 다르다.
Drug-related laboratory evaluation의 CDTM 정의는 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 무제한 독립 diagnosis를 CPA로 부여할 수 없다.
종료 전 치료 연속성 계획과 written notice를 마련하는 행위는 지지된다. 조문은 연속성은 prior to termination, written notice는 when terminated로 구분하므로 advance written notice만이 유일한 법정 시점이라고 단정하지 않는다.
Retail CDTM 자체의 환자연령18세 이상을 확인한다. 별도 prescribing 제도를 혼합하지 않는다.
Physician은 consent 원본을 보관하고 pharmacist에게24시간 내 copy를 전송하며 양쪽은 필요한 referral/consent 기록을 유지한다.

original_explanation_review.boundary_assessment_ko: 9개변형/모델별한문항이라는교육경계를읽었다.그선언을실제distinctness나법규근거로대체하지않고currentdefault0과실제nearest원문을별도로대조했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Retail에서는 supervising physician의 개별 written referral과 primary/secondary diagnosis 정보가 필요하다. 단순 store 신청과 다르다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는개별referral와retailprescribing조건의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.”와E“The physician retains the original consent record and the pharmacist receives and retains the required copy.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.distinct_from_bank: MA-Q-0303canonical원문과MA-CASE-0895public원문/모든보기를직접비교했다. 다른family후보와stem동일=True,완전동일보기=3개. 일부같은행위문구가있지만currentdefault교집합0이고9개연습변형이라는명시경계가있다.이항목만으로중복FAIL을강제하지않는다.상세공유문구와은행맥락을기록했다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의실제행위와scope를판단하며단순성분→schedule분류만을묻지않는다. A의허용행위도그맥락에서판정했다.
criterion_findings_ko.public_style_without_copying: 11/4실제live200으로받은NABP공개samplePDF전문에서SATA의5개보기/SelectALL형식을읽었다.현재문항은그형식만비교했으며sample문구나비공개Pre-MPJE·recall·상업bank는사용하지않았다.

independent_legacy_realism_assessment.finding_ko: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의법률주제와업무가능성은인정하지만위구체보기의추측단서때문에wording기준을충족하지못한다. archivefamily명칭/숫자/템플릿만의일괄실패가아니다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts supervising physician refers a patient for collaborative drug therapy management, records the referral and the patient's consent in his own chart, and tells the collaborating pharmacist that the documentation is complete and nothing further is needed. Where must the individual referral and consent be recorded?

choices.text: In the supervising physician's record alone, which is what the statute requires.
In the pharmacist's record alone, since the pharmacist delivers the service.
In whichever of the two records the professionals agree should hold them.
In the patient's record, by the pharmacist and by the supervising physician.
In a register filed with the Board, separately from the patient's record.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The pharmacist uses a verbal statement that consent exists instead of maintaining the required retail referral/consent records.
A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
The parties arrange uninterrupted therapy and written patient notice before ending the collaboration.
A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.

author_review_blocker: 이번 저자 범위에서 조치가 필요한 법적·키·해설 결함을 발견하지 못했다. 독립 법률/현실성 감사나 공개 승인은 미실행이다.

A.original_choice_text: A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. CDTM 의 drug-related test evaluation 와 독립 diagnosis 범위는 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A CPA specifies permitted laboratory monitoring linked to drug therapy without assigning an independent diagnostic function.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 법문(a)는 약물치료와 직접 관련된 검사 평가를 감독/직접 협의 및 프로토콜 아래 허용하면서 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 제한 없는 새로운 독립 진단권이 아니다.

B.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Retail CDTM 는 written physician referral 와 지정 diagnosis 를 필요로 한다. 일반 서비스 신청으로 대체하지 않는다. 올바른 처리: A retail CDTM pharmacist receives the supervising physician’s patient-specific written referral and diagnosis information.
B.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 16.03(5)(c)의 감독 의사 개별 서면 의뢰·진단정보를 일반 점포 가입 양식으로 대체할 수 없다. CPA와 환자별 의뢰를 별도로 확인해야 한다.

C.original_choice_text: A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 환자 연령은 실제 사용하는 법적 경로에 따라 판단한다. 별도 contraception authority 를 CDTM 에 복사하지 않는다. 올바른 처리: A retail program confirms the patient is at least 18 before using this CDTM pathway.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 이 원문은 retail CDTM 경로다.16.03(5)(a) 및 법문(c)(5)의18세 이상 조건은 다른 피임 경로의 미성년 동의를 가져온다고 사라지지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Retail/community CPA 라도 Schedule II–V prescribing 제한을 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. 올바른 처리: A retail CDTM pharmacist manages an adult patient within the physician referral, signed agreement, and authorized Schedule VI scope.
D.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. retail CDTM의 II–V 처방금지는 CPA에 약을 추가하는 계약으로 없앨 수 없다. alprazolam은 연방 IV이며 여기서 별도 주 전역 처방 경로를 사용하는 것도 아니다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Drug-related laboratory evaluation의 CDTM 정의는 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 무제한 독립 diagnosis를 CPA로 부여할 수 없다.
일반 store sign-up은 physician의 개별 written referral/diagnosis가 아니다.
Community CDTM의 환자는18세 이상이다. 별도 hormonal contraception의 any-person 경로가 retail CDTM 연령을 지우지 않는다.
Retail CDTM은 Schedule II–V prescribing을 허용하지 않는다. Alprazolam은 연방IV이며 CPA에 추가해도 제한이 없어지지 않는다.

original_explanation_review.boundary_assessment_ko: 9개변형/모델별한문항이라는교육경계를읽었다.그선언을실제distinctness나법규근거로대체하지않고currentdefault0과실제nearest원문을별도로대조했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Drug-related laboratory evaluation의 CDTM 정의는 diagnostic component를 제외한다. 무제한 독립 diagnosis를 CPA로 부여할 수 없다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제E의행위는The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은개별referral와retailprescribing조건을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는개별referral와retailprescribing조건의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A CPA uses drug-monitoring authority as unrestricted authority for the pharmacist to make new independent diagnoses.”와E“The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.distinct_from_bank: MA-Q-0341canonical원문과MA-CASE-0896public원문/모든보기를직접비교했다. 다른family후보와stem동일=True,완전동일보기=4개. 동일stem과5개중4개이상동일한행위·판단이라새사실결정이부족하다.보관family존재자체로실패시킨것이아니다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의실제행위와scope를판단하며단순성분→schedule분류만을묻지않는다. E의허용행위도그맥락에서판정했다.
criterion_findings_ko.public_style_without_copying: 11/4실제live200으로받은NABP공개samplePDF전문에서SATA의5개보기/SelectALL형식을읽었다.현재문항은그형식만비교했으며sample문구나비공개Pre-MPJE·recall·상업bank는사용하지않았다.

independent_legacy_realism_assessment.finding_ko: communityCDTM의referral·consent·연령·자격·통지의법률주제와업무가능성은인정하지만위구체보기의추측단서때문에wording기준을충족하지못한다. archivefamily명칭/숫자/템플릿만의일괄실패가아니다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A referred patient at a Massachusetts retail pharmacy has run out of a medication her supervising physician prescribed, and the physician is unreachable. The collaborating pharmacist has never dispensed this patient a different medication for the same condition. What may the pharmacist do under the retail collaborative power?

choices.text: Initiate an equivalent medication for the same condition for up to 30 days.
Extend the current therapy the supervising physician prescribed by 30 days.
Extend the current therapy indefinitely until the physician can be reached.
Substitute a therapeutically similar agent and notify the physician afterwards.
Nothing, because the retail setting confers no continuation power at all.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A Massachusetts community pharmacy is evaluating a CDTM arrangement. The question concerns the retail CDTM pathway, not a separate statewide prescribing statute. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A retail CDTM pharmacist prescribes alprazolam because the physician added it to the retail agreement.
A retail CDTM pharmacist substitutes a general store sign-up form for the physician’s patient-specific written referral.
A retail program applies the separate minor-contraception consent rule to remove CDTM’s adult-patient requirement.
A pharmacist waits until the CPA’s next biennial review to communicate an initial prescription or therapy change.
The pharmacist and supervising physician review and renew the CPA at least every two years.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”와E“A pharmacy separates OTC purchase eligibility from the prescription or order used for insurance billing.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A valid Massachusetts doxycycline prescription for a chlamydia partner uses 'EPT' in place of the partner's name and address. The pharmacist will dispense it. Which record setup is appropriate?

choices.text: Create a separate profile and prescription label using the EPT designation in place of the partner name/address.
Place the partner's doxycycline under the index patient's profile as an extra refill.
Dispense the drug with no profile or label because the partner is unnamed.
Invent a partner date of birth and legal name to make the software accept the prescription.
Convert doxycycline to OTC status for this transaction.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A patient requests a public-health pharmacy service in Massachusetts. Each option identifies the pathway being used; billing rules do not independently expand prescribing authority. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.
A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.
A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.
A pharmacist sells prescription-only ulipristal without an order, applying the OTC status of levonorgestrel emergency contraception.
A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist is dispensing a Schedule II opioid prescribed for a 15-year-old patient. The patient's mother is collecting the medication. The pharmacist has already explained the potential adverse risks of the opioid. What does the statute require next?

choices.text: Nothing further, because a minor cannot be dispensed an opioid antagonist.
Offer to dispense an opioid antagonist to the mother as the minor's parent.
Offer to dispense an opioid antagonist only if the prescriber has also ordered one.
Obtain the prescriber's authorisation before raising an opioid antagonist with the family.
Record that the patient is a minor and treat the antagonist offer as inapplicable.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem:
A patient requests a public-health pharmacy service in Massachusetts. Each option identifies the pathway being used; billing rules do not independently expand prescribing authority. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

choices.text: A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.
A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.
A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock ends the encounter without the required access referral.
A pharmacist sells prescription-only ulipristal without an order, applying the OTC status of levonorgestrel emergency contraception.

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Statewide EC order 의 patient assessment 는 실제 사용자와 수행한다. OTC levonorgestrel 의 제 3 자 구매와 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. DPH EC FAQ는 실제 사용자 평가가 먼저라고 명시한다. 사용자가 없고 필요한 평가도 하지 않은 상태에서 patient-specific 처방을 발행하는 것은 그 경로를 충족하지 못한다.

B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. Model template 와 실제 적격 prescriber 가 발행한 standing order 는 다르다.
B.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. 실제 적용 가능한 signed order와 지정 제품·평가·교부 범위를 확인하는 처리다. 공백 model 자체를 처방 권한으로 취급하지 않는다.

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock ends the encounter without the required access referral.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 재고 미보유 시 해당 nearest-available-location referral 를 수행한다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock refers the requester to the nearest available source.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 9.06(4)는 요청한 rescue kit/승인 antagonist 재고가 없으면 가장 가까운 이용가능 위치로 의뢰하도록 한다. 아무 접근 의뢰 없이 끝내는 것은 이 조건과 맞지 않는다.

D.original_choice_text: A pharmacy conditions a cash purchase of an OTC naloxone product on obtaining a prescription because the insurance workflow uses one.
D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. OTC 적법 구매와 보험 reimbursement 서류는 별개의 판단이다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacy separates OTC purchase eligibility from the prescription or order used for insurance billing.
D.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. FDA가 OTC로 승인한 해당 naloxone의 현금 구매에 보험청구용 처방 경로를 그대로 강제할 근거가 아니다. OTC 적법 구매와 보험 절차를 구별해야 한다.

E.original_choice_text: A pharmacist treats EC standing-order participation as authority to independently prescribe any reproductive-health drug.
E.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Standing order 의 지정 약물·평가·기록 범위가 남는다. 목적이 관련되어도 일반 처방권한이 아니다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist distinguishes permission to dispense under an EC standing order from a general license to prescribe any reproductive-health drug.
E.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. EC standing order는 지정 EC 및 부수 항구토제 평가·교부 경로이며 관련된 모든 생식건강 약의 일반 처방 면허가 아니다. 별도 약사 처방권한도DCP26-08-125의 범위·조건을 따로 따른다.

independent_legacy_legal_assessment.finding_ko: 모든선택지의주체·행위·조건·예외를새공식원문과대조했고현재key와일치한다.해설은해당좁은범위에서지지된다.

original_explanation_review.core_finding_ko: Core의각법률명제를per-choice참조조문과대조했다.일반정의·허용행위·필수기록/통지및제품scope를구분하고확인되지않은추가조건을보충하지않았다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Statewide order에 따른 actual user의 assessment 없이 absent user의 patient-specific EC 처방을 생성할 수 없다. Phone assessment나 OTC third-party 구매를 금지하는 주장은 아니다.
실제 applicable standing order가 있는지 확인하고 그 patient-specific dispensing 경로를 이용한다. Blank model과 이미 발행된 statewide order를 구분한다.
요청 시 stock이 없으면 readily available한 nearest location으로 refer해야 한다. 그 referral을 생략한 처리는 부합하지 않는다.
FDA OTC naloxone product의 cash 구매에 보험 workflow의 Rx 요건을 그대로 적용할 수 없다. 다른 prescription-only naloxone 제형을 모두 OTC라 한 것은 아니다.
EC standing order는 지정 EC/허용된 보조 medication과 assessment를 규정한다. 모든 reproductive-health drug를 독립적으로 처방하는 일반 면허를 부여하지 않는다.

original_explanation_review.boundary_assessment_ko: 9개변형/모델별한문항이라는교육경계를읽었다.그선언을실제distinctness나법규근거로대체하지않고currentdefault0과실제nearest원문을별도로대조했다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide order에 따른 actual user의 assessment 없이 absent user의 patient-specific EC 처방을 생성할 수 없다. Phone assessment나 OTC third-party 구매를 금지하는 주장은 아니다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacist confirms the applicable standing order before using its patient-specific dispensing pathway.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제A의문장“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist confirms the applicable standing order before using its patient-specific dispensing pathway.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”와E“A pharmacist treats EC standing-order participation as authority to independently prescribe any reproductive-health drug.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.distinct_from_bank: MA-Q-0146canonical원문과MA-CASE-0475public원문/모든보기를직접비교했다. 다른family후보와stem동일=False,완전동일보기=3개. 일부같은행위문구가있지만currentdefault교집합0이고9개연습변형이라는명시경계가있다.이항목만으로중복FAIL을강제하지않는다.상세공유문구와은행맥락을기록했다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의실제행위와scope를판단하며단순성분→schedule분류만을묻지않는다. B의허용행위도그맥락에서판정했다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A trained Massachusetts pharmacist has Vivitrol in stock and a patient asks for an injection today. There is no patient-specific prescription or prescriber direction for this dose. What is the best action under the MH/SUD administration guidance?

choices.text: Administer because Vivitrol appears on the eligible-medication list.
Administer if the patient signs a pharmacy consent form.
Do not administer until the required patient-specific prescription/prescriber direction is in place.
Convert the stock dose into an OTC medication.
Ask a technician to select the dose and administer it independently.

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist treats insurance coverage of a contraceptive injection as independent statutory permission to prescribe that injection.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. 보험의 covered product 범위와 pharmacist 의 prescribing scope 는 다르다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist separates a plan’s extended contraception coverage from the pharmacist’s legally authorized prescribing modalities.
A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 보험의 injection 보장은 그 약을 처방할 별도 법적 권한이 아니다. DCP26-08-125는 authorized categories·label/guidance·교육 등의 처방 조건을 별도로 둔다.

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Statewide EC order 의 patient assessment 는 실제 사용자와 수행한다. OTC levonorgestrel 의 제 3 자 구매와 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.
B.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. DPH EC FAQ는 실제 사용자 평가가 먼저라고 명시한다. 사용자가 없고 필요한 평가도 하지 않은 상태에서 patient-specific 처방을 발행하는 것은 그 경로를 충족하지 못한다.

C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. 성분·목적·사용경로가 다르므로 daily contraception 과 EC 를 자동 대체하지 않는다.
C.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. FDA Opill 발표는 일상적 임신 예방을 위한 norgestrel 경구약이며 EC가 아님을 명시한다. 원문의 용도 구분이 정확하다.

D.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. Standing order 의 지정 약물·평가·기록 범위가 남는다. 목적이 관련되어도 일반 처방권한이 아니다.
D.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. standing order 아래 EC 교부 허가와 일반 생식건강 약 처방권한을 구별한다. 지정 제품·평가·기록 및 별도 처방 법규가 남는다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: 보험에서 contraceptive injection을 보장한다는 사실은 independent statutory prescribing 권한이 아니다. 특정별도합법경로가 있다면 그 경로를 따로 충족해야 한다.
Statewide order에 따른 actual user의 assessment 없이 absent user의 patient-specific EC 처방을 생성할 수 없다. Phone assessment나 OTC third-party 구매를 금지하는 주장은 아니다.
Opill은 매일 복용하는 norgestrel 피임약이며 EC가 아니라는 설명은 FDA의 승인 발표와 일치한다.
EC order에 따른 dispensing과 모든 reproductive-health drug에 대한 general prescribing을 구분하는 행위는 지지된다.
Opioid antagonist rescue-kit label과 counseling/information pamphlet은 병존 의무이다. Label만으로 후자를 생략할 수 없다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(보험에서 contraceptive injection을 보장한다는 사실은 independent statutory prescribing 권한이 아니다. 특정별도합법경로가 있다면 그 경로를 따로 충족해야 한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제C의행위는A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist treats insurance coverage of a contraceptive injection as independent statutory permission to prescribe that injection.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.

full_stem_and_all_options.stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist has completed no training programme of any kind. She proposes to dispense emergency contraception under the statewide standing order this week, and to dispense a COVID-19 drug under a standing order next week. How do the two proposals compare?

choices.text: The emergency contraception dispensing may proceed; the COVID-19 drug may not.
The COVID-19 dispensing may proceed; the emergency contraception may not.
Both may proceed, because training is a professional expectation rather than a bar.
Neither may proceed, because both regimes require approved training beforehand.
Both may proceed once she notifies the Department that she intends to dispense.

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. 성분·목적·사용경로가 다르므로 daily contraception 과 EC 를 자동 대체하지 않는다.
A.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. FDA Opill 발표는 일상적 임신 예방을 위한 norgestrel 경구약이며 EC가 아님을 명시한다. 원문의 용도 구분이 정확하다.

B.original_choice_text: A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.
B.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Statewide EC order 의 patient assessment 는 실제 사용자와 수행한다. OTC levonorgestrel 의 제 3 자 구매와 구별한다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.
B.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. DPH EC FAQ는 실제 사용자 평가가 먼저라고 명시한다. 사용자가 없고 필요한 평가도 하지 않은 상태에서 patient-specific 처방을 발행하는 것은 그 경로를 충족하지 못한다.

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacist treats a blank model standing-order template as a signed order authorizing dispensing.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택하지 않을 항목. Model template 와 실제 적격 prescriber 가 발행한 standing order 는 다르다. 올바른 처리: A pharmacist confirms the applicable standing order before using its patient-specific dispensing pathway.
C.finding_ko: 이 사례의 오답. 공백 template는 처방자가 실제 발행한 적격 standing order가 아니다. 공식 EC order는 의사 서명·면허번호·발행일을 갖고 있으며 그 지정 범위 안에서만 사용할 수 있다.

D.original_choice_text: A pharmacist distinguishes permission to dispense under an EC standing order from a general license to prescribe any reproductive-health drug.

D.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. standing order 아래 EC 교부 허가와 일반 생식건강 약 처방권한을 구별한다. 지정 제품·평가·기록 및 별도 처방 법규가 남는다.

choice_findings.finding_ko: Opill은 매일 복용하는 norgestrel 피임약이며 EC가 아니라는 설명은 FDA의 승인 발표와 일치한다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Opill은 매일 복용하는 norgestrel 피임약이며 EC가 아니라는 설명은 FDA의 승인 발표와 일치한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답B=A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacist generates a statewide-order EC prescription for an absent user without the required patient assessment.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist explains that Opill is a daily norgestrel contraceptive rather than emergency contraception.”와E“A pharmacy dispenses an opioid-antagonist rescue kit with the required counseling and information material.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Statewide EC order의 사용자를 직접 또는 전화로 assess해야 한다. OTC EC의 제3자 구매와 별개이다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제A의행위는A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답D=A pharmacy conditions a cash purchase of an OTC naloxone product on obtaining a prescription because the insurance workflow uses one.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제D의문장“A pharmacy conditions a cash purchase of an OTC naloxone product on obtaining a prescription because the insurance workflow uses one.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist using the statewide emergency-contraception order assesses the person who will take the medication, in person or by telephone.”와E“A pharmacist distinguishes permission to dispense under an EC standing order from a general license to prescribe any reproductive-health drug.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.distinct_from_bank: MA-Q-0325canonical원문과MA-CASE-0905public원문/모든보기를직접비교했다. 다른family후보와stem동일=True,완전동일보기=2개. 일부같은행위문구가있지만currentdefault교집합0이고9개연습변형이라는명시경계가있다.이항목만으로중복FAIL을강제하지않는다.상세공유문구와은행맥락을기록했다.
criterion_findings_ko.not_schedule_flashcard: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의실제행위와scope를판단하며단순성분→schedule분류만을묻지않는다. A의허용행위도그맥락에서판정했다.
criterion_findings_ko.public_style_without_copying: 11/4실제live200으로받은NABP공개samplePDF전문에서SATA의5개보기/SelectALL형식을읽었다.현재문항은그형식만비교했으며sample문구나비공개Pre-MPJE·recall·상업bank는사용하지않았다.

independent_legacy_realism_assessment.finding_ko: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의법률주제와업무가능성은인정하지만위구체보기의추측단서때문에wording기준을충족하지못한다. archivefamily명칭/숫자/템플릿만의일괄실패가아니다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(보험에서 contraceptive injection을 보장한다는 사실은 independent statutory prescribing 권한이 아니다. 특정별도합법경로가 있다면 그 경로를 따로 충족해야 한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제C의행위는A pharmacy separates OTC purchase eligibility from the prescription or order used for insurance billing.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist treats insurance coverage of a contraceptive injection as independent statutory permission to prescribe that injection.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제B의문장“A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock ends the encounter without the required access referral.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacy separates OTC purchase eligibility from the prescription or order used for insurance billing.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(Opill은 daily norgestrel 피임약이며 FDA는 emergency contraception 용도가 아니라고 명시한다. 요청 목적을 확인하지 않고 EC와 자동 대체하면 안 된다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
criterion_findings_ko.practice_plausibility: 약국이별도기록별로EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting를검토하는업무는가능하다. 실제B의행위는A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.이고statedprerequisites안에서평가했다.
criterion_findings_ko.authentic_distractors: 이문항의오답은standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분을혼동한다. 실제오답A=A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.를공식조문과비교했다.다만실질혼동주제와별개로답의방향을노출하는표현은아래wording판정의결함이다.
criterion_findings_ko.wording_not_guessable: FAIL: 실제C의문장“A pharmacy lacking requested opioid-antagonist stock ends the encounter without the required access referral.”는명시적자기모순·불필요한위험행위또는규정준수자체를답으로쓴표현이다. 정답측“A pharmacy maintains separate records for EC annual reporting and ordinary prescription dispensing.”의안전/적격/적용요건준수표현과대조되어법규구체조건을묻기전에해당보기의선택방향을준다.나머지보기일부에는실제제품/조문지식이필요하다는점은위reasoning판정에따로인정했다.단순SATA구조나family반복만을실패이유로쓰지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.reasoning_not_trivia: A/E는standingorder범위와OTC/보험청구구분의적용관계를묻는다.날짜·schedule암기만으로모든실질근거를설명할수는없다.그실질주제와별개로현문구의추측가능성이남는다.
criterion_findings_ko.natural_rule_combination: 서로별도기록이라는stem을그대로적용하면EC·OTC피임·naloxone의접근·order·reporting의서비스/처방검토안에서결합된다. A와E를한환자의동일사건이라고합치지않았다.
criterion_findings_ko.appropriate_drug_context: 실제보기A“A pharmacist supplies daily norgestrel Opill in place of requested emergency contraception without clarifying the intended use.”와E“A pharmacy treats the rescue-kit label as replacing the applicable counseling and information-material obligations.”의약품/경로/인력사실이법적범위판단에연결된다.약품명이없는CPA/등록문항에불필요한brand를요구하지않았다.

choices.text: A single combined annual return satisfies all three regimes.

Each report must identify the individual patients supplied.

A.original_choice_text: A pharmacist distinguishes Brixadi weekly and monthly products before processing the ordered formulation.
A.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. 같은 성분이라도 formulation·regimen·제품 조건이 다르다. Generic 이름만으로 임의 교환하지 않는다.
A.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. BRIXADI§2.1은 weekly/monthly를 서로 다른 제형이라 하고 weekly 용량을 합쳐 동등 monthly 용량으로 만들지 못한다고 명시한다. 주문 제형을 구별하는 처리가 맞다.

C.original_choice_text: A pharmacist continues to consider clozapine’s label-based neutropenia monitoring and patient safety after REMS removal.
C.original_choice_rationale_ko: 선택할 항목. REMS administrative requirement 제거와 neutropenia risk·label 기반 monitoring 은 다르다.
C.finding_ko: 지원되는 처리. FDA는 REMS 제거 후에도 처방자가 라벨 빈도에 따라 ANC를 계속 모니터링하고 환자에게 호중구감소 위험을 상담하도록 권고한다. 약국의 폐지된 프로그램 관문과 임상 안전을 구별한 처리다.

criterion_findings_ko.jurisprudence_reasoning: 제품별REMS·formulation·시행시점에대한법적판단이있다. A의판정(BRIXADI weekly와 monthly는 다른 formulation/interval이다. Weekly doses를 합쳐 monthly dose로 만들 수 없고 환자별 ordered formulation과 승인된 conversion을 확인한다.)과E의조건을구분해야한다.
